user.title: Select an RF receiver
user.description: Choose one receiver already tuned for your station’s 2-FSK signal. The Home Assistant modulation label does not tune the radio.

no_receiver.title: No usable receiver
no_receiver.description: Connect an ESPHome RF receive channel or native RF receiver. Confirm receive capability and raw timing forwarding, then submit to retry.

method.title: Identify your station
method.description: Discovery listens to the station's regular broadcasts. No pairing or button press is required, and nothing is sent to the station.

retry.title: Station not confirmed
retry.description: No verified packet arrived within 75 seconds, the receiver disconnected, or you declined the station. Check receiver tuning and timing capture.

manual.title: Enter your station ID
manual.description: Enter 0x followed by four hexadecimal digits, or a decimal number. The verified weather format uses channel 0. Manual setup can proceed while the station is silent; measurements remain unavailable until received.

confirm.title: Confirm station {sensor_id}
confirm.description: Station {sensor_id}, channel {channel}. Confirm this is your station, not a neighbor’s. If unsure, verify its ID using a capture or controlled power cycle before proceeding.

reconfigure.title: Replace receiver or station ID
reconfigure.description: Use after a receiver replacement or station battery change. Existing entities and history are preserved. New station IDs start a new rain baseline without adding historical rain.

progress.listening: Listening for up to 75 seconds. A station normally transmits about every 20 seconds.

error.receiver_unusable: Select a connected receiver with receive capability.
error.invalid_sensor_id: Enter a 16-bit ID such as 0x7203 or 29187.
error.already_configured: This station ID and channel are already configured.

data_description.signal_timeout: 60–600 seconds. Default: 90 seconds, allowing several missed 20-second transmissions.
